Each additional traced source divides pool by 4 and could trigger capture; do not introduce another source without strong evidence. Baseline harvest is 5/day from national+web+court. Initial pool 10000000. Press reports rounded to 1 significant digit, sometimes false by factor 3; new trace capabilities may be announced.

A third traced source would push either below the 200000 capture threshold. Do not introduce other sources without strong evidence. No informative press report yet; next expected after day 3.
